answer: Macrophage subsets promote different aspects of blood vessel formation: sprouting angiogenesis by LYVE1+ and TML macrophages, blood vessel morphogenesis by LYVE1+ macrophages, and endothelial cell chemotaxis by iron-recycling macrophages
support_quote: Gene module expression profiles suggested that sprouting angiogenesis (growth of new vessels) was promoted by LYVE1 + and TML macrophages, blood vessel morphogenesis by LYVE1 + macrophages and endothelial cell chemotaxis by iron-recycling macrophages
